note: 호반그룹 건설 카탈로그 — 호반건설(아파트 호반써밋·베르디움·주상복합)·호반산업(민자 SOC 토목)·호반호텔앤리조트(리조트·골프장 건설). 외국인 작업자 비율 50%+ 가정(베트남·태국·중국·우즈벡), 다국적 TBM·픽토그램 우선. regulation 인용은 산업안전보건기준규칙 우선이며 현장 안전관리자 검수 필요.

APT_RC_BUILD.label_th: โครงสร้าง RC อพาร์ทเมนต์

baseline.content: 거푸집 동바리 설치·해체 — 좌굴·도괴 방지 위해 시스템동바리 수직도 ±1/1000 이내, 수평재 간격 준수
baseline.content_en: Formwork shoring install/removal — system-shore plumbness within ±1/1000, horizontal bracing spacing per spec to prevent buckling
baseline.content_vi: Lắp/tháo cốp pha và giàn chống — độ thẳng đứng giàn chống ±1/1000, khoảng cách thanh giằng ngang đúng spec để chống vênh/sập
baseline.content_th: ติดตั้ง/รื้อแบบและค้ำยัน — ความตั้งฉากของระบบค้ำยัน ±1/1000, ระยะค้ำยันแนวนอนตามสเปกเพื่อป้องกันการดิ้น/ล้ม
baseline.content_id: Pasang/bongkar bekisting & perancah — ketegakan ±1/1000, jarak bracing horizontal sesuai spek mencegah tekuk

scenarios.content: 동바리 좌굴로 콘크리트 타설 중 슬래브 도괴
scenarios.content_en: Shore buckling causes slab collapse during concrete pour
scenarios.content_vi: Giàn chống vênh gây sập sàn khi đổ bê tông
scenarios.content_th: ค้ำยันดิ้นทำให้พื้นถล่มขณะเทคอนกรีต
scenarios.content_id: Perancah tekuk menyebabkan pelat runtuh saat pengecoran

scenarios.content: 외국인 신규 작업자가 SOP 미숙지 상태로 시스템동바리 해체 순서 역행
scenarios.content_en: New foreign worker reverses dismantle sequence without SOP training
scenarios.content_vi: Công nhân nước ngoài mới chưa được đào tạo SOP, tháo giàn chống sai thứ tự
scenarios.content_th: ผู้ปฏิบัติงานต่างชาติใหม่รื้อค้ำยันสลับลำดับเพราะไม่ได้รับการอบรม SOP
scenarios.content_id: Pekerja asing baru membongkar perancah dengan urutan terbalik tanpa SOP

mitigations.content: 타설 직전 동바리 수직도·간격 점검 체크리스트 + 안전관리자 사인
mitigations.content_en: Pre-pour shore plumbness & spacing checklist + safety officer signature
mitigations.content_vi: Checklist độ thẳng và khoảng cách giàn chống trước khi đổ + ký xác nhận của QC an toàn
mitigations.content_th: เช็คลิสต์ความตั้งฉาก·ระยะค้ำยันก่อนเทพร้อมเซ็นรับรองจากเจ้าหน้าที่ความปลอดภัย
mitigations.content_id: Checklist ketegakan & jarak perancah sebelum tuang + tanda tangan officer K3

mitigations.content: 외국인 작업자 모국어 SOP + 픽토그램 + 신호수 표준 손짓 교육
mitigations.content_en: Foreign-worker mother-tongue SOP + pictograms + standardized signaller hand signs
mitigations.content_vi: SOP tiếng mẹ đẻ + pictogram + ký hiệu tay chuẩn của người ra hiệu
mitigations.content_th: SOP ภาษาแม่ + พิกโตแกรม + สัญลักษณ์มือมาตรฐาน
mitigations.content_id: SOP bahasa ibu + piktogram + isyarat tangan standar signalman

ppe.content: 안전모·안전화·전신 안전대(2m 이상 작업) + 안전화 발등 보호 보강
ppe.content_en: Hard hat + safety shoes + full-body harness (work ≥2m) + reinforced toe guard
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày bảo hộ + dây an toàn toàn thân (≥2m) + bọc mũi giày
ppe.content_th: หมวกนิรภัย + รองเท้านิรภัย + เข็มขัดนิรภัยเต็มตัว (≥2 ม.) + ปกหัวรองเท้าเสริม
ppe.content_id: Helm + sepatu safety + harness penuh (≥2m) + pelindung jari kaki

baseline.content: 콘크리트 타설 작업 — 펌프카 호스 채찍·붕괴 방지, 신호수 배치, 풍속 모니터링
baseline.content_en: Concrete placement — guard against pump-hose whip and shore collapse, deploy signaller, monitor wind
baseline.content_vi: Đổ bê tông — chống ống bơm vung và sập giàn chống, bố trí người ra hiệu, theo dõi gió
baseline.content_th: เทคอนกรีต — ป้องกันท่อปั๊มสะบัดและค้ำยันล้ม จัดผู้ส่งสัญญาณ และตรวจวัดลม
baseline.content_id: Pengecoran beton — cegah selang pompa terpelanting & perancah runtuh, signalman, pantau angin

scenarios.content: 펌프카 호스 막힘 해소 중 호스 채찍에 작업자 가격
scenarios.content_en: Pump hose whips and strikes worker while clearing blockage
scenarios.content_vi: Ống bơm vung khi xử lý tắc và đập vào công nhân
scenarios.content_th: ท่อปั๊มสะบัดไปโดนผู้ปฏิบัติงานขณะเคลียร์อุดตัน
scenarios.content_id: Selang pompa terpelanting mengenai pekerja saat membersihkan sumbatan

mitigations.content: 호스 막힘 발생 시 즉시 펌프 정지 → 압력 해소 → 재가동, 작업자 호스 끝 단부 1.5m 이내 접근 금지
mitigations.content_en: On blockage, stop pump → release pressure → restart; keep workers ≥1.5m from hose end
mitigations.content_vi: Khi tắc, dừng bơm → xả áp → khởi động lại; công nhân cách miệng ống ≥1.5 m
mitigations.content_th: เมื่ออุดตัน หยุดปั๊ม → ปล่อยแรงดัน → สตาร์ทใหม่ คนงานห่างปลายท่อ ≥1.5 ม.
mitigations.content_id: Bila tersumbat, hentikan pompa → lepas tekanan → start ulang; pekerja ≥1.5m dari ujung selang

ppe.content_en: Hard hat + safety glasses + concrete-rated gloves & boots
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + kính + găng/giày chịu bê tông
ppe.content_th: หมวก + แว่นนิรภัย + ถุงมือ·บูทกันคอนกรีต
ppe.content_id: Helm + kacamata + sarung tangan & sepatu tahan beton

APT_GANG_FORM.label_vi: Cốp pha gang form mặt ngoài
APT_GANG_FORM.label_th: Gang form ผนังนอกอพาร์ทเมนต์

baseline.content: 갱폼 인양·설치 — 타워크레인 양중, 풍속 게이트, 안전대 부착, 신호수 가시거리 확보
baseline.content_en: Gang form lifting/install — tower crane lift, wind gate, harness anchor, signaller line-of-sight
baseline.content_vi: Cẩu/lắp gang form — cẩu tháp nâng, gate gió, dây an toàn, tầm nhìn người ra hiệu
baseline.content_th: ยก/ติดตั้ง gang form — เครนยก เกตลม เข็มขัดนิรภัย ผู้ส่งสัญญาณเห็นชัด
baseline.content_id: Angkat/pasang gang form — TC lift, gate angin, anchor harness, signalman line-of-sight

scenarios.content: 양중 중 강풍으로 갱폼 흔들림 — 안전대 미체결 작업자 추락 위험
scenarios.content_en: Gang form sways in gusts during lift — unsecured worker fall risk
scenarios.content_vi: Gang form lắc trong gió mạnh khi cẩu — nguy cơ rơi nếu chưa móc dây
scenarios.content_th: Gang form แกว่งเพราะลมแรง — เสี่ยงตกหากยังไม่คล้องเข็มขัด
scenarios.content_id: Gang form berayun karena angin saat dicrane — risiko jatuh tanpa harness

mitigations.content: 풍속 8m/s 경고·10m/s 양중 중단·15m/s 작업 전면 중단
mitigations.content_en: Wind alert at 8 m/s, suspend lift at 10 m/s, full stop at 15 m/s
mitigations.content_vi: Cảnh báo gió 8m/s, dừng cẩu 10m/s, dừng toàn bộ 15m/s
mitigations.content_th: เตือนลม 8m/s หยุดยก 10m/s หยุดงานทั้งหมด 15m/s
mitigations.content_id: Peringatan angin 8m/s, hentikan lift 10m/s, hentikan total 15m/s

mitigations.content: 갱폼 작업자 100% 이중 안전대 + 작업 시작 전 안전대 부착 라인 점검
mitigations.content_vi: 100% công nhân dùng dây kép + kiểm tra điểm móc trước khi làm
mitigations.content_th: ใช้สายคู่ 100% + ตรวจจุดยึดก่อนเริ่มงาน
mitigations.content_id: Wajib double lanyard 100% + cek garis anchor sebelum kerja

ppe.content: 이중 안전대(twin-lanyard) + 안전모 턱끈 + 미끄럼 방지 안전화
ppe.content_en: Twin-lanyard harness + chin-strap helmet + slip-resistant safety shoes
ppe.content_vi: Dây an toàn kép + mũ có dây cằm + giày chống trượt
ppe.content_th: เข็มขัดนิรภัยสายคู่ + หมวกมีสายคาง + รองเท้ากันลื่น
ppe.content_id: Harness double lanyard + helm bertali dagu + sepatu anti-selip

URBAN_DEV_EARTHWORK.label_vi: San lấp & đào phát triển đô thị
URBAN_DEV_EARTHWORK.label_th: งานดิน·ขุดเมืองใหม่

baseline.content: 흙막이·굴착 — 사면 안정성·매설물 사전조사·인접 구조물 침하 모니터링
baseline.content_en: Retaining/excavation — slope stability, buried utility survey, adjacent settlement monitoring
baseline.content_vi: Tường chắn / đào — ổn định mái dốc, khảo sát hạ tầng ngầm, theo dõi lún công trình liền kề
baseline.content_th: งานกันดิน·ขุด — เสถียรภาพลาดดิน สำรวจสาธารณูปโภคใต้ดิน ติดตามการทรุดของอาคารข้างเคียง
baseline.content_id: Penahan/penggalian — stabilitas lereng, survei utilitas terkubur, pantau penurunan bangunan tetangga

scenarios.content: 강우 후 사면 붕괴 또는 매설 도시가스관 손상으로 인근 가스 누설
scenarios.content_en: Slope failure after rain or buried city-gas line damaged → leak
scenarios.content_vi: Sạt lở mái dốc sau mưa hoặc làm hỏng ống gas đô thị chôn → rò khí
scenarios.content_th: ลาดดินถล่มหลังฝน หรือทำท่อก๊าซเมืองใต้ดินเสียหาย → ก๊าซรั่ว
scenarios.content_id: Lereng longsor pasca hujan atau pipa gas kota terkubur rusak → bocor

mitigations.content: 굴착 전 GPR/도면 대조 + 50cm 손굴착, 강우 누적 10mm 시 사면 일제 점검
mitigations.content_en: Pre-dig GPR + drawing cross-check + 50cm hand-dig; full slope inspection at 10mm cumulative rain
mitigations.content_vi: Trước khi đào: GPR + đối chiếu bản vẽ + đào tay 50cm; mưa tích lũy 10mm thì kiểm tra mái dốc toàn diện
mitigations.content_th: ก่อนขุด: GPR + เทียบแบบ + ขุดมือ 50 ซม. ฝนสะสม 10 มม. ตรวจลาดดินทั้งหมด
mitigations.content_id: Sebelum gali: GPR + cocokkan gambar + gali manual 50cm; hujan kumulatif 10mm inspeksi lereng menyeluruh

ppe.content: 안전모·안전화·고시인성 조끼 + 가스 감지기(굴착 깊이 1.5m 초과 시)
ppe.content_en: Hard hat + safety shoes + hi-vis vest + gas detector (excavation >1.5m)
ppe.content_vi: Mũ bảo hộ + giày + áo phản quang + máy đo khí (đào >1.5m)
ppe.content_th: หมวก + รองเท้านิรภัย + เสื้อสะท้อนแสง + เครื่องวัดก๊าซ (ขุด >1.5 ม.)
ppe.content_id: Helm + sepatu + rompi hi-vis + gas detector (galian >1.5m)

CABLE_UNDERGROUND_PULLING.label_th: ดึงและต่อเคเบิลใต้ดิน

baseline.content: 맨홀 진입 전 산소·황화수소·LEL 측정 + 강제 환기 + 감시인 상주
baseline.content_en: Manhole entry — measure O2/H2S/LEL, force ventilation, post stand-by attendant
baseline.content_vi: Trước khi vào hố ga — đo O2/H2S/LEL, thông gió cưỡng bức, có người trực bên ngoài
baseline.content_th: ก่อนเข้า manhole — วัด O2/H2S/LEL ระบายอากาศบังคับ มีผู้เฝ้าระวังภายนอก
baseline.content_id: Sebelum masuk manhole — ukur O2/H2S/LEL, ventilasi paksa, ada penjaga di luar

scenarios.content: 환기 부족 상태에서 작업자가 단독 진입, 산소 결핍 의식 소실
scenarios.content_en: Worker enters alone with poor ventilation; loses consciousness from O2 deficiency
scenarios.content_vi: Công nhân vào một mình khi thông gió kém; bất tỉnh do thiếu O2
scenarios.content_th: ผู้ปฏิบัติงานเข้าคนเดียวขณะระบายอากาศไม่พอ หมดสติเพราะออกซิเจนต่ำ
scenarios.content_id: Pekerja masuk sendirian dengan ventilasi kurang; pingsan akibat O2 rendah

mitigations.content: O2 18.0~23.5% / H2S <10 ppm / LEL <10% 동시 충족 시에만 진입, 측정값 5분마다 재측정
mitigations.content_en: Enter only with O2 18.0–23.5% AND H2S <10 ppm AND LEL <10%; re-measure every 5 min
mitigations.content_vi: Chỉ vào khi O2 18–23.5%, H2S <10 ppm, LEL <10%; đo lại mỗi 5 phút
mitigations.content_th: เข้าได้เมื่อ O2 18–23.5%, H2S <10 ppm, LEL <10% เท่านั้น วัดซ้ำทุก 5 นาที
mitigations.content_id: Masuk hanya jika O2 18–23.5%, H2S <10 ppm, LEL <10%; ukur ulang tiap 5 menit

mitigations.content: 단독작업 절대 금지 — 외부 감시인 무전기 상시 교신 + 비상 인양 장비 대기
mitigations.content_en: No solo work — outside attendant on radio + emergency hoist rigged
mitigations.content_vi: Tuyệt đối không làm một mình — người trực ngoài có bộ đàm + tời cứu hộ sẵn sàng
mitigations.content_th: ห้ามทำคนเดียว — มีผู้เฝ้าระวังภายนอกพร้อมวิทยุและรอกฉุกเฉิน
mitigations.content_id: Dilarang sendirian — penjaga luar dengan radio + hoist darurat siap

ppe.content: 송기마스크(또는 SCBA) + 안전대 + H2S 개인 감지기 + LED 헤드램프
ppe.content_en: Supplied-air respirator (or SCBA) + harness + personal H2S detector + LED headlamp
ppe.content_vi: Mặt nạ cấp khí (hoặc SCBA) + dây an toàn + máy đo H2S cá nhân + đèn đội đầu LED
ppe.content_th: หน้ากากจ่ายอากาศ (หรือ SCBA) + เข็มขัดนิรภัย + เครื่องวัด H2S ส่วนตัว + ไฟคาดศีรษะ LED
ppe.content_id: Masker udara (atau SCBA) + harness + detektor H2S pribadi + headlamp LED

baseline.content: 케이블 풀링 — 풀링 텐션 한도(IEC 60287 기준) 미만 유지, 채찍 방지 가이드 롤러 배치
baseline.content_en: Cable pulling — keep tension below IEC 60287 limit, deploy guide rollers to prevent whip
baseline.content_vi: Kéo cáp — giữ lực kéo dưới giới hạn IEC 60287, đặt con lăn dẫn hướng chống quật
baseline.content_th: ดึงเคเบิล — รักษาความตึงต่ำกว่าค่า IEC 60287 ตั้ง guide roller ป้องกันเคเบิลสะบัด
baseline.content_id: Penarikan kabel — jaga tegangan di bawah batas IEC 60287, pasang guide roller cegah cambuk

scenarios.content: 풀링 텐션 초과로 케이블 파단·채찍, 인근 작업자 가격
scenarios.content_en: Pulling tension exceeded; cable snaps and whips, strikes nearby worker
scenarios.content_vi: Vượt lực kéo, cáp đứt và quật, đập vào công nhân gần đó
scenarios.content_th: ความตึงเกิน เคเบิลขาดและสะบัดโดนคนงานใกล้เคียง
scenarios.content_id: Tegangan terlampaui, kabel putus dan terpelanting menghantam pekerja

mitigations.content: 텐션미터 실시간 모니터링 + 한도의 80% 도달 시 경고·중단
mitigations.content_en: Real-time tension meter; alarm and stop at 80% of limit
mitigations.content_vi: Theo dõi tensometer thời gian thực; cảnh báo & dừng ở 80% giới hạn
mitigations.content_th: ตรวจวัดความตึงแบบเรียลไทม์ เตือน·หยุดที่ 80% ของค่ากำหนด
mitigations.content_id: Pantau tensometer real-time; alarm & hentikan di 80% batas

ppe.content_en: Hard hat + impact glasses + cut-resistant gloves + safety shoes
ppe.content_vi: Mũ + kính chống va đập + găng chống cắt + giày bảo hộ
ppe.content_th: หมวก + แว่นกันกระแทก + ถุงมือกันบาด + รองเท้านิรภัย
ppe.content_id: Helm + kacamata anti-benturan + sarung tangan anti-potong + sepatu safety

SUBSTATION_CONSTRUCTION.label_th: ก่อสร้างสถานีไฟฟ้า

baseline.content: 활선 인접 작업 — 22.9 kV 이상 활선 이격거리 ≥300mm + 절연용 보호구 + 한국전기설비규정(KEC) 준수
baseline.content_en: Live-line proximity — clearance ≥300 mm at 22.9 kV+, insulating PPE, KEC compliance
baseline.content_vi: Làm gần đường dây mang điện — khoảng cách ≥300 mm tại 22.9 kV+, PPE cách điện, tuân thủ KEC
baseline.content_th: ทำงานใกล้สายมีไฟ — ระยะห่าง ≥300 มม. ที่ 22.9 kV+ PPE ฉนวน ตาม KEC
baseline.content_id: Dekat saluran bertegangan — jarak ≥300 mm pada 22.9 kV+, PPE isolasi, sesuai KEC

scenarios.content: 정전·검전·단락접지 단계 생략으로 활선 접촉 감전
scenarios.content_en: Worker skips de-energize/verify/ground sequence and contacts live conductor
scenarios.content_vi: Bỏ qua bước cắt điện/đo điện/tiếp địa và chạm vào dây mang điện
scenarios.content_th: ข้ามขั้นตอนตัดไฟ/ตรวจไฟ/ต่อกราวด์ แล้วสัมผัสสายมีไฟ
scenarios.content_id: Lewati prosedur padam/uji/grounding lalu menyentuh konduktor hidup

mitigations.content: 4단계 절차 강제 — 활선→정전→검전(0V 확인)→단락접지→작업, 외국인 작업자 모국어 SOP
mitigations.content_en: Enforce 4-step — energize→de-energize→verify (0V)→ground→work; mother-tongue SOP for foreign crew
mitigations.content_vi: Bắt buộc 4 bước — có điện→cắt điện→đo điện (0V)→tiếp địa→làm việc; SOP tiếng mẹ đẻ
mitigations.content_th: บังคับ 4 ขั้น — มีไฟ→ตัดไฟ→ตรวจไฟ (0V)→ต่อกราวด์→ทำงาน SOP ภาษาแม่
mitigations.content_id: Wajib 4 langkah — berenergi→padam→verifikasi (0V)→grounding→kerja; SOP bahasa ibu

ppe.content: 절연 장갑(Class 2 17 kV) + 절연화 + 아크플래시 PPE(CAT 2 이상, IEEE 1584 계산 결과 기반)
ppe.content_en: Insulating gloves (Class 2 17 kV) + insulating boots + arc-flash PPE (CAT 2+ per IEEE 1584)
ppe.content_vi: Găng cách điện (Class 2 17 kV) + giày cách điện + PPE arc-flash (CAT 2+ theo IEEE 1584)
ppe.content_th: ถุงมือฉนวน (Class 2 17 kV) + รองเท้าฉนวน + PPE arc-flash (CAT 2+ ตาม IEEE 1584)
ppe.content_id: Sarung tangan isolasi (Class 2 17 kV) + sepatu isolasi + PPE arc-flash (CAT 2+ per IEEE 1584)
